page.layout: One page of text, no marginal notes. Running head at top with page number at top right. Running text, then a centred heading "VERSVS IIII.", then an italic verse quotation, then a paragraph with Greek. Signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: dei hostes,nunc hos adoriuntur, nūc illos. Nisi autem ij, qui de sancto Christi & Euangelij nomine gloriatur, fratribus oppressis, modis omnibus & apud Deum pijs precibus, & contra hostes consilio, manuq; (si quidem hac sit opus, in defensione legiti-ma) adfint, opemq; eis ferant: certò futurū versis rerum vicibus, ut illi quidem qui diu oppressi fuerant, emergant, & de manu inimicorum liberentur:hi verò defertores fratrum, iustissimo Dei iudicio, Antichristianorum violenta manu redigantur ad extrema. Mutationes enim istæ sunt dexteræ excelsi.
main_text.head: VERSVS IIII.

p.i: Quāuis exaltares velut aquila, & quāuis inter stellas poneres nidum tuum, inde deijcerem te, dictum Iehoua.

main_text.p: Hic versus habet primo παραμυθολογίαν [?], seu concessionem etiam τὴς ἀλλωσέως [?]. Age, statuamus Idumaeis, non tantum in editissimis montibus & rupibus habitare datum esse: sed etiam in altissima aeris regione, quam Aquilae pererrare solent: imò in firmamento coeli inter ipsa sidera: ad quae nulla hominum vis ascendere potest: deinde ἀνασκευωγικὴν [?] tacitam, quae exadducta ratione peti
[?] The Greek words in the two places above are doubtful readings; the scan is too faint to confirm each letter.

page.notes: Page number "55" is read from a worn, long-s style figure at the top right; confirm. Greek terms (παραμυθολογίαν, τὴς ἀλλωσέως, ἀνασκευωγικὴν) are uncertain because of print and scan quality. Printed "fidera" read as "sidera" (long s). Printed "fi quidem" read as "si quidem"; "adfint" kept as printed. Printed "s" forms normalised to s throughout. Line-end hyphen in "legiti-ma" kept as printed. The verse heading and quotation are printed in capitals and italic respectively.
